213:t_000:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I checked the $$ジェニオン$$'s data, and it looks like we're... near the center of the galaxy...」

213:t_000:7.en:
$n
「The center... of the galaxy... Then that $$時空震動$$ sent us flying...」

213:t_000:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes... It looks like we're... adrift in this sea of stars...」

218:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar～

218:t_1:6.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Those are the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ you were fighting, aren't they, $$レド$$...?」

218:t_1:8.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What the hell is going on!? Where are we now!?」

218:t_1:9.en:
$$レド$$
「Think of it as exactly the reverse of what happened to me.」

218:t_1:11.en:
$$エイミー$$
「We've... come to the place where you were fighting, $$レド$$?」

218:t_1:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey...! Can't we go home!?」

218:t_1:16.en:
$$レド$$
「Hyperspace navigation over such immense distances, spanning roughly half the galaxy, has not been established...」

218:t_1:17.en:
$$レド$$
「The same applies to this $$マクロス・クォーター$$.」

218:t_1:21.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Then we'll just have to keep living here, won't we?」

218:t_1:23.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You got sent here all alone, but you've been doing your best with the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ and $c. I'll do the same.」

218:t_1:25.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hey, $$レド$$... This is where you used to be, right...?」

218:t_1:26.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Then will you go back to the $$人類銀河同盟$$?」

218:t_1:28.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, tin can! Is there a way to get back to that whatever-it-is Alliance!?」

218:t_1:29.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「More detailed positional data is required to answer.」

218:t_1:30.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「However, the probability of rejoining the $$人類銀河同盟$$ is at least higher than it was on Earth.」

218:t_1:31.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It sounds like you can go home, $$レド$$!」

218:t_1:32.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I request Ensign $$レド$$'s decision on that matter.」

218:t_1:33.en:
$$レド$$
「...First, we must assess the situation. I'll consider the Alliance later.」

218:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
(Until $$エイミー$$ asked, I hadn't even thought about returning...)

218:t_1:36.en:
$$レド$$
(What... do I want to do...?)

218:t_1:37.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Is that a $$人類銀河同盟$$ $$マシンキャリバー$$...?」

218:t_1:39.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I've never encountered them myself, but the 《$$ギャラクシー船団$$》 has data on them.」

218:t_1:41.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「It's one of the super long-range emigrant fleets, like our $$フロンティア船団$$.」

218:t_1:42.en:
$$ルカ$$
「They tried to use the $$バジュラ$$'s power during the $$再世戦争$$, and fought against us.」

218:t_1:43.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「They controlled my mind, and I fought $$アルト$$ and the others as their soldier.」

218:t_1:44.en:
$$アルト$$
「But $$ブレラ$$ broke free and became a member of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

218:t_1:45.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「How did someone like that end up in the middle of the galaxy?」

218:t_1:46.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「A $$時空震動$$ right after the $$再世戦争$$ transported me to the center of the galaxy.」

218:t_1:47.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「As a cyborg, I shut down my biological functions and drifted through space, broadcasting a distress signal. About nine months later, the $$マクロス７船団$$ rescued me.」

218:t_1:48.en:
$$アルト$$
「I see... I thought only $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ had been transported to the same world as us...」

218:t_1:49.en:
$$アルト$$
「So the $$マクロス７船団$$ came too.」

218:t_1:50.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「$$アルト$$... I heard $$ランカ$$ is aboard this ship too...」

218:t_1:52.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ブレラ$$... Sorry to ask, but could you go see $$ランカ$$?」

218:t_1:53.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Of course, but is $$ランカ$$ unwell?」

218:t_1:54.en:
$$オズマ$$
「She's been through a few things that shook her up lately...」

218:t_1:55.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Even with you and $$アルト$$ beside her, Major $$オズマ$$...?」

218:t_1:57.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「All right... ...Major, please take me to her.」

218:t_1:58.en:
$$オズマ$$
「...Everyone, remain on standby. Once the captain of the $$バトル７$$ finishes talking with our representatives, we'll be briefed on the situation.」

218:t_1:59.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Until then, collect yourselves and be ready for any situation.」

218:t_1:62.en:
$$クラン$$
「After what we've just experienced, that hardly sounds like an exaggerated threat.」

218:t_1:63.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「What's... going to happen to us...?」

218:t_1:64.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't worry so much! We've got allies in the $$マクロス７船団$$ too!」

218:t_1:65.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's right. For a coincidence like this to happen in such a vast universe... it's a miracle.」

218:t_1:66.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「A miracle, huh... If this really was a coincidence, I guess that's the only word for it.」

218:t_1:67.en:
$$ルカ$$
「I think $$ブレラ$$... was about to say something about that.」

218:t_1:68.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「We can ask him after he's finished talking to $$ランカ$$-chan.」

218:t_1:70.en:
$$カイエン$$
「What's wrong, $$アルト$$? Is something bothering you?」

218:t_1:71.en:
$$アルト$$
「...The $$マクロス７船団$$ should have the same composition as our $$フロンティア船団$$.」

218:t_1:72.en:
$$アルト$$
「But only the escort fleet's flagship, the $$バトル７$$, is here.」

218:t_1:74.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「It's operating alone... Maybe the $$バトル７$$ is on some kind of mission.」

218:t_1:75.en:
$$ルカ$$
「And $$ブレラ$$ went ahead of them to carry out that mission...?」

218:t_1:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「We'll have all the answers soon.」

218:t_1:77.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But we already know what we need to do.」
